problem:
Problem description
- There is a single planning horizon $$\tau$$, and the problem is a static allocation problem over that horizon.
- There are $$|\mathcal{W}|$$ workshops indexed by $$w\in\mathcal{W}$$.
- There are $$|\mathcal{C}|$$ components indexed by $$c\in\mathcal{C}$$.
- Each workshop $$w$$ has a limited available production time of $$H_w$$ hours.
- Each workshop has a component-specific production rate $$R_{w,c}$$, meaning that allocating one hour of workshop $$w$$ to component $$c$$ produces output at rate $$R_{w,c}$$ units per hour.
- A finished product is formed by combining one unit of every component in $$\mathcal{C}$$.
- The total number of finished products is therefore limited by the least available component quantity after all workshop production is completed.
- The planning goal is to decide how many hours each workshop should allocate to each component so that the number of completed products is as large as possible.
- There are no explicit cost trade-offs in the base problem; the objective is driven only by finished-product maximization.
- Required business constraints:
  - Each workshop must allocate no more than its available hours $$H_w$$ across all components.
  - Each workshop-hour allocation must be nonnegative.
  - A workshop’s production time can be assigned to at most one component at a time.
  - Component output is determined by the allocated hours and the corresponding rate $$R_{w,c}$$.
  - The quantity of each completed product cannot exceed the available quantity of any component.
  - The final plan must respect the assembly rule that one finished product requires one unit of every component.
- A solution is represented by:
  - $$X_{w,c}$$: the number of hours workshop $$w$$ allocates to component $$c$$.
  - $$Q_c$$: the total quantity of component $$c$$ produced across all workshops.
  - $$Z$$: the total number of completed products assembled.

Input Format
{
  "time_horizon": "Single planning horizon $$\\tau$$ for a static allocation decision.",
  "workshops": "List of workshop identifiers representing $$\\mathcal{W}$$, with size $$|\\mathcal{W}|$$.",
  "components": "List of component identifiers representing $$\\mathcal{C}$$, with size $$|\\mathcal{C}|$$.",
  "available_hours": "Vector $$H\\in\\mathbb{R}_+^{|\\mathcal{W}|}$$, where $$H_w$$ is the available production hours for workshop $$w$$.",
  "production_rate": "Matrix $$R\\in\\mathbb{R}_+^{|\\mathcal{W}|\\times|\\mathcal{C}|}$$, where $$R_{w,c}$$ is the units of component $$c$$ produced per hour by workshop $$w$$.",
  "component_requirement": "Vector $$a\\in\\mathbb{R}_+^{|\\mathcal{C}|}$$, where $$a_c$$ is the number of units of component $$c$$ needed for one finished product; in this problem, $$a_c=1$$ for all $$c\\in\\mathcal{C}$$.",
  "unit_cost": "Optional matrix $$K\\in\\mathbb{R}_+^{|\\mathcal{W}|\\times|\\mathcal{C}|}$$ for per-hour or per-unit costs, if a cost variant is used; not required in the base problem."
}

Output Format
{
  "hours_allocation": "Matrix $$X\\in\\mathbb{R}_+^{|\\mathcal{W}|\\times|\\mathcal{C}|}$$, where $$X_{w,c}$$ is the allocated hours from workshop $$w$$ to component $$c$$.",
  "component_totals": "Vector $$Q\\in\\mathbb{R}_+^{|\\mathcal{C}|}$$, where $$Q_c$$ is the total produced quantity of component $$c$$.",
  "completed_products": "Scalar $$Z\\in\\mathbb{Z}_+$$ giving the maximum number of finished products achieved."
}

Example(s)

Input 1
{
  "time_horizon": "single_period",
  "workshops": ["A", "B", "C", "D"],
  "components": ["Component 1", "Component 2", "Component 3"],
  "available_hours": {
    "A": 100,
    "B": 150,
    "C": 80,
    "D": 200
  },
  "production_rate": {
    "A": {
      "Component 1": 10,
      "Component 2": 15,
      "Component 3": 5
    },
    "B": {
      "Component 1": 15,
      "Component 2": 10,
      "Component 3": 5
    },
    "C": {
      "Component 1": 20,
      "Component 2": 5,
      "Component 3": 10
    },
    "D": {
      "Component 1": 10,
      "Component 2": 15,
      "Component 3": 20
    }
  },
  "component_requirement": {
    "Component 1": 1,
    "Component 2": 1,
    "Component 3": 1
  }
}

parameters.name: time_horizon
parameters.description: Single planning horizon for the static allocation decision

parameters.name: available_hours
parameters.description: Available production hours for each workshop

parameters.name: production_rate
parameters.description: Production rate of each workshop for each component in units per hour

parameters.name: component_requirement
parameters.description: Units of each component required per finished product

variables.name: allocation_hours
variables.description: Hours allocated by each workshop to each component

variables.name: component_total
variables.description: Total quantity produced for each component across all workshops

variables.name: completed_products
variables.description: Total number of completed products assembled

constraints.name: workshop_hour_capacity
constraints.description: each workshop may allocate no more than its available production hours across all components

constraints.name: nonnegative_allocation_hours
constraints.description: allocation hours must be nonnegative for every workshop-component pair

constraints.name: nonnegative_component_totals
constraints.description: component totals must be nonnegative for every component

constraints.name: integer_completed_products
constraints.description: completed products must be a nonnegative integer count

constraints.name: component_output_aggregation
constraints.description: each component total is obtained by aggregating production from all workshops based on allocation hours and production rates

constraints.name: finished_product_component_bottleneck
constraints.description: the number of finished products cannot exceed the available quantity of any required component

objectives.name: maximize_completed_products
objectives.description: maximize the total number of completed products assembled

final_objective.description: maximize the total number of completed products assembled
